messages.subject: P Marsden — settlement signed
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin — good news: the settlement agreement is signed by both parties and the adviser's certificate is in. Executed copy attached for the file. Headlines: £95,000 ex gratia (£30k tax free), £24,850 bonus, £4,380 holiday, £5,000 outplacement, £1,500 + VAT fees; non-compete 9 months with garden-leave set-off; customer covenants 12 months; agreed reference. Termination date 31 March. Rebecca — payment schedule to follow for payroll.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield | Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
